title: Home to Frontier Station: an Outer Rim scout far from Altais docks at its capital, where its region's work is
note: Written by Oracle, 2026-11-23 05:22 UTC (orders ENT-076 P6: newborns work where they were born, far only by a route's far_ok; rule F8). Before census.py end_stop (5ae15927) a census that docked nowhere sent its ship to Central Nexus; five Outer Rim scouts stood docked 14 to 17 jumps from Altais at 05:19 UTC and waited, every route of their list closed by the newborn guard ('work in its own region first') or full (fill.py status scout). far_ok lifts the guard for this one stop home; last in the Rim rows, so a ship at home with work never takes it. Empty hold (rule F3).
